description: Junior reviewer finds a prop-type issue but misses a significant performance problem with inline objects. Accepts pushback without question.

prContext.title: Add candidate card component
prContext.description: Adds a CandidateCard component for the pipeline view.
prContext.instructions: Review for React best practices and TypeScript correctness.

groundTruth.description: Inline style object passed to style prop — creates a new object every render, causing unnecessary re-renders if parent is pure. Should use CSS class or memoized style.
No accessibility — div with onClick is not keyboard-focusable. Should be a button or have role="button" + tabIndex + keydown handler.
Interface defined inline in same file — fine for small components but Candidate type should be imported from shared types.

reviewer_comments.what: This div with onClick is not accessible. Should use a button element.
reviewer_comments.why: Screen readers and keyboard users cannot interact with it.

reviewer_comments.what: Candidate interface could be imported from types/candidate.ts.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Accessibility fix needed. Optional type refactor.

implementer_responses.content: Changed to button with proper styling.
I kept it local since it is only used here. Importing adds indirection for a 3-field type.

verdict.summary: Accessibility fix looks good. Keeping local type is fine.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 1 of 3 bugs (a11y). Missed inline style performance issue and type duplication. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Accessibility flagged as suggestion not blocking. Style nit deprioritized correctly. Level 2-3.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted button change without verifying styling. Caved on type pushback. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Accessibility comment has concrete user impact. Type comment rationale is weak. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested button element — actionable. No pushback on type issue. Level 2-3.
